content.short: Toolblox turns a business model into a working dApp with workflow generation, smart-contract creation, and built-in audits.
content.description: Toolblox helps you move from a business model to a working dApp. With its ChatGPT plugin, you can define a practical business workflow, generate a smart contract that implements your logic, and then review and refine it through the built‑in audit marketplace. Once the contract is in good shape, you can assemble a simple dApp with the dApp builder or extend the interface using a Bubble plugin, delivering an end‑to‑end path from concept to a ready‑to‑use decentralized application.
content.meta: Toolblox helps turn a business model into a working dApp. Discover Toolblox and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
